summary.headline: Astrological Questions 152–172
summary.text: Catalog of astrological questions and procedures in a Venetian codex, covering inheritance, adversaries, judicial aid, letters from Zoroaster, tyranny, elected times, hidden things, pregnancy, truces, rulers, restoration, coincidence, outcomes, the Sun as apheta, house lordship, and good fortune. Abu Ma'shar is cited, with a cross-reference to codex 6 and an appendix.
